mutations.name: a later reservation no longer yields to an earlier one
kills: which reservations a PR waits behind lets the earlier of two overlapping reservations go and holds the later one

mutations.name: the rule's ignore globs are not applied
kills: which paths two PRs overlap on never counts changeset files or generated files such as CAPABILITIES.md

mutations.name: a reservation never expires
kills: which reservations a PR waits behind stops waiting once the reservation is older than the TTL or its run no longer drives
